trailhead.name: Pacific Crest Trail at Canebrake Road (park at Chimney Creek Campground)

identifiedBy.fact: Chimney Creek Campground, standard PCT route to the crest saddle; PCT also used in 2013 report, 2020 account (PCT crossing, short drive from Chimney Creek BLM campground), and climber.org driving page lists PCT crossing as Spanish Needle trailhead and says park at the campground

notes: Moderate confidence. Opened: climber.org 2006/1559 (Chimney Creek campground, PCT called standard), 2013/1828 (via earlier pass: PCT crossing at Canebrake Rd), wacziarg 2020 (PCT crossing at Canebrake Rd; reaches saddle north of massif), climber.org driving/canebrake.html (PCT crossing serves Spanish Needle; park at campground; also lists Canebrake saddle CANLAM for Lamont/Spanish Needle and Sand Canyon alternative). Other starts: 2001/828 and themtsarecalling used the Lamont Meadow 4WD road then reached the PCT; 2000/687 used Sand Canyon/Rodecker Flat (east side, different route). None used the north ridge exactly; the route text (PCT saddle north of summit) fits the PCT start. Plurality, not a strong majority. Placement is a land-manager coordinate for the campground; the PCT crossing is just south of it (BLM page).

trailhead.name: Culebra (Main) Trailhead, Cielo Vista Ranch north headquarters gate (check-in), then ranch road

identifiedBy.fact: 14ers.com lists one trailhead for Culebra, Culebra (Main), at the ranch north HQ gate; every party books with the ranch and checks in at HQ, then drives the 4WD road to Four Way or the upper trailhead

placements.name: Culebra/Whiskey Pass Accesses - Cielo Vista Trailhead

otherFacts.value: private ranch, advance booking, fee ~$150, gate check-in ~6:00 am

notes: The three starts on the route page (ranch HQ, Four Way, upper TH) are the same trip by vehicle choice; the ranch gate/HQ is the one public start for all. The two printed coordinates (14ers rounded, climb13ers to the second) agree, at ~9,100 ft near the north gate, not at HQ itself (HQ ~2 mi beyond, no coordinate). USFS candidates 16+ km north do not apply.

trailhead.name: Santanoni Range trailhead (Santanoni Road, Bradley Pond trail), off Upper Works Road, Newcomb

identifiedBy.fact: drive Upper Works Road, turn left on Santanoni Road, trailhead 50 ft ahead; gravel road ~1.8 mi, then trail past Bradley Pond to ridge junction, straight for Couchsachraga

otherFacts.value: 44.089134,-74.056277 (adirondackhub; the Upper Works High Peaks lot, NOT this trailhead)

notes: Weak to moderate. Only one start in practice; the question was the signed trailhead. Opened: pureadirondacks (Santanoni trailhead on Santanoni Road, 50 ft past turn off Upper Works Road), cnyhiking (lot ~2.0 mi from the 28N-side junction; older text), lakeplacid 2013 (says Upper Works; approach road then Bradley Lean-to foot trail), adirondackhub and newcombny.gov (Upper Works lot at the road end; neither mentions the Santanoni range), Gaia (Bradley Pond trail/Santanoni Road). The Upper Works lot at the road end is a different, farther lot (Calamity Brook etc.), so stored 'Upper Works' is the road name, not the lot. A search snippet cited Trailforks 44.14191,-74.1069 for the Bradley Pond start, but Trailforks returned 403 and it is not an allowed placement source. No NYSDEC page opened. Placements empty.
